hannah: heads-up: customer reported hosted->private fallback broke. runtime rejected payload: "unrecognized field 'poly_assets'"

oleg: poly_assets? that's our new extensible attachments region. older adapters expect `assets` or `attachments`.

priya: quick status: probe manifest for that tenant only had `envelope_core_v1` capability. hosted started shipping poly_assets behind a feature flag last week.

chris: hmm. two failure modes: we either force strict capability negotiation (fail early), or we translate in the control plane on-the-fly, or make runtimes lenient. each has tradeoffs.

hannah: leaning away from lenient runtimes; silent acceptance masks real contract drift.

oleg: agree. but strict handshake breaks air-gapped installs instantly. customers will want a clear migration path.

priya: proposal: introduce a small capability bit `envelope_poly_v1`. Hosted control-plane will do soft-translation when capability missing: add header `X-Envelope-Normalized: true`, increment `envelope_normalizations` metric, and attempt deterministic mapping `poly_assets -> assets`. If mapping touches opaque blobs (signed_manifest, kms_blob) and cannot preserve exact bytes, translation aborts and we return 409 + {code:"upgrade_required"}.

chris: addendum: gate translation per-tenant with a feature-flag so we can turn it off if CPU/latency regressions show up. Also require translation to run < 10ms P99 or we abort to avoid SLO regressions.

oleg: technical note: translation must be reversible where possible and must never re-sign or mutate opaque tokens. If translation requires re-wrap, it must fail.

priya: will surface telemetry: `envelope_normalizations_ratio` and `envelope_normalization_latency_ms`. Add alert if ratio > 1% for 5m or if latency P50 > 20ms increase.

hannah: for Dedicated we will publish a tiny shim `env-compat` crate that normalizes envelopes at runtime. recommend customers enable shim or upgrade adapter within 90 days.

probe-bot: probe-run: adapter-probe job 7702 on staging succeeded 2026-03-26T08:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

chris: next steps: priya draft RFC with API sketch for `ProbeResponse.capabilities`, translation pseudocode, tests in `probe-harness`, tenant feature-flag instrumentation, and rollback runbook. i'll attach to eng-arch review.

oleg: also add a short ADR entry in hosting ADRs referencing the decision and migration timelines.

hannah: thanks. let's keep translation minimal and observable. ping when RFC ready.
